nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Make sure to adjust the number of tiles and overlap to fit your hardware.
(fewer tiles will result in faster execution, but will require more memory).

### Recommended settings

| node settings (pixels)                     | resolved latent geometry        |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `512 / 64 / 128 / 32`                      | 16x16, ov 2 - 16f ov 4 |
| `768 / 192 / 128 / 32`                     | 24x24, ov 6 - 16f ov 4 |
| `1024 / 256 / 128 / 48`                    | 32x32, ov 8 - 16f, ov 6         |
| `1536 / 384 / 192 / 48`                    | 48x48, ov 12 - 24f, ov 6        |
| `768 / 192 / spatial-only`                 | 24x24, ov 6 - no temporal split |

nodes.title: Inputs
widgets_values:
## Inputs

Everything here is optional.

### Prompt

Enter a positive prompt. To rewrite it into a fuller description first, enable
**enhance positive prompt** on the Input Parameters node below. The negative
prompt is used as written and is never enhanced.

Supplying an **LTX API key** encodes and enhances the prompt through the API
instead of locally, which saves memory. The workflow switches over on its own
whenever a key is present - there is nothing to un-bypass.

See the [prompting guide](https://docs.ltx.io/open-source-model/usage-guides/prompting-guide).

### Image input

Condition the video to open on a still by loading an image and enabling
**use image input** on the Input Parameters node.

### Source video

The source video is the subject of the edit. Its frames are resized and handed
straight to the IC-LoRA as guide frames.

Its width, height, length and frame rate drive the whole generation, and its audio
track is carried through so the result keeps the original sound. The deblur
**IC-LoRA** is loaded in **Load Models**, the guide frames are injected in
**Preprocess**, then cropped out during sampling.

## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ IC-LoRA Deblur - ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-deblur-0.9.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Deblur/blob/main/ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-deblur-0.9.safetensors)

nodes.title: Generate
widgets_values:
## Generate

**Sampler - Distilled (8 steps)**

Runs the distilled ltx-2.5 model with the deblur IC-LoRA applied, in 8
steps. You can change the noise seed, the guider cfg (used for both video and
audio) and the sampler. The guide frames are cropped out afterwards
(`LTXVCropGuides`) so only the generated video is decoded.

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

Builds the audio-video latent at the **source video's** size and length, conditions on the optional start image, sets the conditioning frame rate from the source fps, and injects the source **guide frames** via the IC-LoRA (`LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide`).

The source audio is encoded and frozen (`LTXVSetAudioRefTokens`), so it is carried through denoising unchanged rather than regenerated.

The guide frames are cropped out after sampling (`LTXVCropGuides`) so only the generated video is decoded.

groups.title: Load Models - one file per output
Input Image - pass only if use_image
Prompt Text Encode via API for more memory efficient run

widgets_values: Do explore various samplers and cfg values (although we advise them to be kept close to 1)

nodes.title: Source video → guide frames
widgets_values:
## Source video

Everything the generation is sized and timed by comes from here. The frames are
resized to the generation resolution and handed to the IC-LoRA as guide frames,
and the width, height, length and frame rate are all read off this video.

The audio track is passed through too, so the result keeps the original sound.
